primer: PCBL Chemical Limited (NSE: PCBL), an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group firm, is India's largest carbon black maker (~790–880 KTPA capacity, 122 MW captive power). It is also expanding into specialty blacks, water and oilfield chemicals via Aquapharm, and battery materials via Nanovace. Core carbon black cash flow is strong (FY26 CFO ₹1,576 Cr), but the ₹3,800 Cr Aquapharm buyout pushed debt to ₹5,083 Cr. That debt cut ROCE to 8% and brought Negative credit outlooks from CRISIL and ICRA. At ₹282.55 (40.96x TTM P/E, ~15.3x EV/EBITDA) in a Stage 4 downtrend below its 30-week SMA (₹306.17), new capital is REJECTED.
sizing_table_takeaway: No new position sizing is authorized because PCBL is REJECTED on Valuation (Base fair value ₹250 < CMP ₹282.55) and Stage 4 Trend (CAP_REJECTED).
